name: open-cake
description: Open Cake — Bizcity Open Customer Framework (web): contact_id là trục xuyên mọi kênh. GPL-2.0-or-later.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/contracts && tsc -p packages/care-kernel && tsc -p packages/ui-kit && tsc -p packages/action-client && tsc -p apps/web && npm run build -w @open-cake/contracts && npm run build -w @open-cake/care-kernel && tsc -p apps/api --noEmit
scripts.api:build: npm run build -w @open-cake/contracts && npm run build -w @open-cake/care-kernel && npm run build -w @open-cake/api
